title: 第九章 洗澡第十章 顺利
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 宴席渐进尾声，佳肴美馔已享用得差不多了。（太玄殿前不宜饮酒，大致便是这般氛围。）
坐在季南北身侧的那名男弟子，瞧见季南北面前空空如也、甚至能映出倒影的碟盘，整个人直接怔住了。
“是给萧师妹这桌的菜肴没上齐全吗?”
最终，他得出了这个结论。
季南北摆了摆手。
“不妨事。”
萧京溪没忍住，在神识里轻笑出声。
很快有侍者上前撤换餐碟，不过负责处理季南北这一桌的人，看到这满桌空盘也愣了愣神。
嗯?
我上菜的时候漏了?
虽然疑惑，却也没多问。
早膳过后，剑青城将目光投向了季南北。
“如何，为师昨日与你提的那件事，考虑得怎样了?”
季南北并未感到意外。
因为来时路上，萧京溪已将这所谓的“事情”向他透过底。
昨日他离开后，萧京溪便被师尊召见，交代了一桩任务。
事情说来简单，便是剑青城希望萧京溪作为仙灵剑宗年轻一代的代表，带队下山游历一番，顺道去其他两宗三派走动走动。说白了，就是带着人出去转一圈，找同属顶尖大派的朋友们聊聊天、品品茶。
途中或许会有些小考验，但基本都属小打小闹，以萧京溪的实力，一路平推过去也不难。
倒也算是个美差。
同时，身为萧京溪师尊的剑青城，也想借此机会让自家弟子多与同辈交流。
毕竟自家这徒儿，性情实在有些特别。
就没听说她和哪个弟子走得近，甚至连个朋友都没有。
此外，修真界年轻一辈似乎即将有一场大型集会，届时少不了切磋比试。
萧京溪这“小剑仙”的名号，连同“正道年轻一代第一人”的称谓，便是上次集会时打出来的。
此番让萧京溪外出走动，也算为此做些准备。
说起比斗......
季南北想起自己似乎一个月后也要参加什么比试。
不过，季南北没把两件事联系起来，毕竟他身在魔道，时间也完全对不上就是了。
话说回来，萧京溪昨日听师尊提及此事时，本是打算直接回绝的。
嗯，完全不想出门走动，更不愿和其他宗门的人打交道。
但自家师尊态度颇为坚决，还是觉得萧京溪该出去见见世面，别总闷在宗门里。还有一个缘由......
那便是季南北。
因为季南北的出现，让萧京溪也生出些不同的念头。
季南北知晓此事后，也问过萧京溪的想法。
萧京溪沉默了许久，反问季南北一句:
“那你能陪我一起去吗?”
季南北想都没想便应了下来。
他肯定得来萧京溪这儿修炼，而且，季南北也想瞧瞧外面的世界究竟是何模样。
本体困于深山，萧京溪则常在宗门内，两边都不便随意走动。
正巧有这般机会，出去看看也好。
于是系统任务面板便弹了出来。
【已触发任务，请从以下三项中选择一项进行回应。】
选项一:你在教我做事?嚷嚷什么!又不是没有高阶修士带队!（奖励:五十万魔道点数，七品功法《大寂灭掌》。）
选项二:外头不过一群乌合之众，有何可交流?我萧京溪一人足矣镇压全场!（奖励:十万魔道点数，五品灵宝《风月bao鉴》。）
content_en:
The banquet is coming to an end, and the delicious food is almost finished. (It is not advisable to drink alcohol in front of Taixuan Hall, this is the atmosphere.)
The male disciple sitting next to Ji Nanbei was stunned when he saw the empty plate in front of Ji Nanbei that even reflected his reflection.
"Is it because the dishes on the table for Junior Sister Xiao are not complete?"
Eventually, he came to this conclusion.
Ji Nanbei waved his hand.
"It doesn't matter."
Xiao Jingxi couldn't hold back and chuckled in her consciousness.
Soon a waiter came forward to replace the dishes, but the person responsible for Ji Nanbei's table was stunned when he saw the table full of empty plates.
Huh?
Did I miss it when I served it?
Although he was confused, he didn't ask any more questions.
After breakfast, Jian Qingcheng turned his attention to Ji Nanbei.
"How about it? How have you considered the matter that I mentioned to you yesterday?"
Ji Nanbei was not surprised.
Because on the way here, Xiao Jingxi had already explained this so-called "thing" to him.
After he left yesterday, Xiao Jingxi was summoned by his master and given a task.
To put it simply, Jian Qingcheng hopes that Xiao Jingxi, as a representative of the younger generation of the Xianling Sword Sect, will lead a team to travel down the mountain and visit the other two sects and three sects along the way. To put it bluntly, it means taking people out for a walk, chatting with friends from the same top sect, and drinking tea.
There may be some small tests along the way, but they are basically minor challenges. With Xiao Jingxi’s strength, it is not difficult to push through them all the way.
It's not a bad job.
At the same time, as Master Xiao Jingxi, Jian Qingcheng also wanted to take this opportunity to let his disciples communicate more with their peers.
After all, my disciple has a really special temperament.
I didn't hear that she was close to any of her disciples, and she didn't even have any friends.
In addition, it seems that the younger generation of the cultivation world is about to have a large-scale gathering, where competition and competition will be indispensable.
Xiao Jingxi's title of "Little Sword Immortal", together with the title of "The First Person of the Righteous Young Generation", were given at the last meeting.
Letting Xiao Jingxi go out for a walk this time can be considered as preparation for this.
Speaking of competition...
Ji Nanbei remembered that he seemed to be participating in some competition in a month.
However, Ji Nanbei didn't connect the two things. After all, he was in the devil's path, and the time was completely inconsistent.
Having said that, when Xiao Jingxi heard her master mention this matter yesterday, she originally planned to refuse it directly.
She...
Well, I don’t want to go out and walk around at all, let alone interact with people from other sects.
However, his master's attitude was quite firm and he still felt that Xiao Jingxi should go out and see the world instead of being bored in the sect. There is another reason...
That is Ji Nanbei.
Because of Ji Nanbei's appearance, Xiao Jingxi also had some different thoughts.
After Ji Nanbei learned about this, he also asked Xiao Jingxi what he thought.
Xiao Jingxi was silent for a long time, then asked Ji Nanbei:
"Then can you go with me?"
Ji Nanbei agreed without thinking.
He must come to Xiao Jingxi to practice, and Ji Nanbei also wanted to see what the outside world was like.
The main body is trapped in the mountains, while Xiao Jingxi is always in the sect, making it inconvenient for both parties to move around freely.
If you happen to have such an opportunity, it might as well go out and take a look.
Then the system task panel pops up.
[The task has been triggered, please choose one of the following three to respond. 】
Option 1: Are you teaching me how to do things? What are you yelling about! It’s not like there are no high-level monks to lead the team! (Reward: 500,000 magic points, seventh-grade skill "Great Nirvana Palm".)
Option 2: There is just a bunch of rabble outside, what can we communicate with? I, Xiao Jingxi, can suppress the whole crowd by myself! (Reward: 100,000 magic points, fifth-grade spiritual treasure "Fengyue Baojian".)
